## Setup

```{r packages + settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(socsci)
library(geomtextpath)
library(coolorrr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggridges)
library(here)
library(countrycode)
library(patchwork)
set_palette(
  qualitative = c(
    "steelblue",
    "orange",
    "navy",
    "red",
    "green3"
  ),
  binary = c("gray30", "red"),
  sequential = c("white", "navy"),
  diverging = c("steelblue", "gray", "red3")
)
source(here::here("_helpers", "splot.R"))
theme_set(my_theme())
saveit <- function(num = 1, ht = 5, wd = 7) {
  ggsave(
    here::here(
      "116_war_trends",
      paste0("fig", num, ".png")
    ),
    height = ht,
    width = wd,
    dpi = 500
  )
}
```

## Data

```{r}
library(peacesciencer)
source(here("_helpers", "dyadify_ucdp.R"))
read_csv(
  here("_data", "ucdp-dyadic-261-csv", "Dyadic_v26_1.csv")
) -> ac_dt
ac_dt |>
  dyadify_ucdp() -> dyadic_dt
```


## Figures

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7
dyadic_dt |>
  filter(gwcode1 == 2) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(total = n_distinct(conflict_id)) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(year, total) +
  geom_col(fill = "gray") +
  geom_col(
    data = . %>% filter(year %in% 2017:2020),
    fill = "orange3"
  ) +
  geom_col(
    data = . %>% filter(year == 2025),
    fill = "navy"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = . %>% filter(year == 2025),
    aes(label = "Trump 2.0"),
    nudge_x = -10,
    nudge_y = 0,
    family = "mono",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "navy"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = . %>% filter(year == 2019),
    aes(label = "Trump 1.0"),
    nudge_x = -10,
    nudge_y = 0,
    family = "mono",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "orange3"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1945, 2025, by = 10)
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust =1),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. involvement in conflict back up in 2025",
    subtitle = "Count of armed conflicts with >24 battle deaths with U.S. troops involved",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = logo
  )
saveit(1)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7
dyadic_dt |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    n = n_distinct(conflict_id)
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(year, n) +
  geom_col(
    fill = "gray"
  ) +
  geom_col(
    data = . %>% filter(year == 2025),
    fill = "navy"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = . %>% filter(year == 2025),
    label = "65 in 2025",
    color = "navy",
    nudge_x = -10,
    nudge_y = 0,
    family = "mono",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 was record-setting",
    subtitle = "Total armed conflicts with >24 annual battle deaths, 1946-2025",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    caption = logo
  ) 
saveit(2)
```
